qualification:
Specialized688-byte equality case of the actual CBMC/libc memcmp boundary.
Scalar content equality is the precondition, not a second call to memcmp.
Same-pointer and distinct owned-array instances are checked; transport to every
caller/heap layout and any eventual replacement must remain explicit.
domain: Every688-byte value; one same-start pointer or two distinct owned array objects carrying equal values. Precondition uses the previously extracted scalar prefix loop. Actual native C ABI memcmp and its normal Kani library model execute, with an empty-write-set/zero-return contract. Other pointer/overlap layouts, source caller installation and any C-model replacement remain unproved by this leaf.
